// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  int tiles   = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  // Hoist flush and config outside all loops — format is invariant
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
      1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

#define J_BATCH 4

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;
    int pad_i = BLK - mrows;

    // Stage A scales for this i0 row-block (reused across all j0 batches)
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);

    // Mvin A tiles once per i0 — reused across J_BATCH j0-blocks
    uint32_t a_base = 0;
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
          a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0 += J_BATCH) {
      int jbatch = J_BATCH;
      if (j0 + jbatch > BLOCKS_N) jbatch = BLOCKS_N - j0;

      int tiles_J_big = tiles * jbatch;

      // Check scratchpad capacity:
      // A: tiles * tiles_K * DIM rows
      // B: tiles_J_big * tiles_K * DIM rows
      // Total must fit in BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS = 8192 rows
      // For J_BATCH=4: 2*32*16 + 8*32*16 = 1024+4096 = 5120 <= 8192 OK
      // Accumulator: tiles * tiles_J_big * DIM = 2*8*16 = 256 <= 256 OK

      // Compute ncols for each j in batch; last j-block may be partial
      int pad_j = 0;
      {
        int last_ncols = REAL_N - (j0 + jbatch - 1) * BLK;
        if (last_ncols > BLK) last_ncols = BLK;
        if (last_ncols < 0) last_ncols = 0;
        pad_j = BLK - last_ncols;
      }

      // Build combined B scales for all jbatch blocks
      // B_s_batch layout: B_s_batch[g][jj*BLK .. (jj+1)*BLK-1]
      for (int jj = 0; jj < jbatch; jj++)
        for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
          memcpy(&B_s_batch[g][jj * BLK], &B_scales_col[g][(j0 + jj) * BLK], BLK);

      // B base: top of scratchpad, growing downward
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_J_big * tiles_K * DIM;

      // Load A and B scale factors
      // sel=0 for A (activation), sel=1 for B (weight)
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s_batch, (size_t)jbatch * B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Mvin B tiles for all jbatch j-blocks
      // B tile layout: b_base + (j_global * tiles_K + k) * DIM
      // where j_global = jj * tiles + j
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int jj = 0; jj < jbatch; jj++)
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
          for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
            gemmini_extended_mvin(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 + jj) * BLK + j * DIM),
              b_base + ((jj * tiles + j) * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Configure output stride and requantizer
      // i_bound=tiles, j_bound=tiles_J_big, k_bound=tiles_K must match loop_ws_spad
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
          tiles, tiles_J_big, tiles_K,
          /*scale_act_sel*/0, /*scale_w_sel*/0, /*lut_update_granularity*/1);

      // Compute: fused hardware loop over tiles x tiles_J_big x tiles_K
      // mx_loop_spad_marker is one-shot; gemmini_loop_ws_spad re-issues funct 24
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles_J_big, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
          a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
          false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain results from mx_smem to DRAM
      // smem layout: row r, j-batch block jj, column within block
      // smem word offset for (r, jj): SPAD_DEST*16 + r * (tiles_J_big * BLK) + jj * BLK
      for (int jj = 0; jj < jbatch; jj++) {
        int ncols = REAL_N - (j0 + jj) * BLK;
        if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
        if (ncols <= 0) continue;
        for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
          gemmini_mx_read_smem(
            &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 + jj) * BLK / BF16_PER_WORD],
            SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * (tiles_J_big * BLK) + jj * BLK,
            ncols);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
